exercises.text: 1. What is the physical meaning of the refractive index of light?
lines: 1. What is the physical meaning of the refractive index of light?
exercises.source_text: 1. 光的折射率的物理含义是什么？

exercises.text: 2. In your exercise book, use a red pencil to write '优' ('Excellent'), and use a green pencil to write '良' ('Good') to its left. You have two pieces of glass, one green and one red. Through which piece should you look to see the mark '优' ('Excellent') clearly?
lines: 2. In your exercise book, use a red pencil to write '优' ('Excellent'), and use a green pencil to write '良' ('Good') to its left. You have two pieces of glass, one green and one red. Through which piece should you look to see the mark '优' ('Excellent') clearly?
exercises.source_text: 2. 在练习本上用红铅笔写上“优”，在它的左边用绿铅笔写上“良”. 现有两块玻璃——绿色的和红色的，为了看清评语“优”，应该通过哪块玻璃来看？

exercises.text: 3. Why does a very narrow beam form a clearly separated spectrum after passing through a prism, whereas a wide beam shows colour only at its edges?
lines: 3. Why does a very narrow beam form a clearly separated spectrum after passing through a prism, whereas a wide beam shows colour only at its edges?
exercises.source_text: 3. 为什么只有很窄的光束通过棱镜以后才能形成光谱，而宽光束只在边缘才呈现彩色？
